foreign_title: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
aka: 史诺比开心呈献：在家千日好(港)
description: Snoopy is devastated when his beloved doghouse is accidentally sold at a yard sale. In an effort to cheer up his pal, Charlie Brown leads Snoopy on an adventure to find his old doghouse, and along the way, they learn what makes a house truly a home.
